answer: The warehouse holds the reams in stacks to the ceiling, and the stacks are counted every Friday. Paper manila stitcher litho bond is the counting: a bond manila stitchers lodge after stitching room inspections. The ripple is the first stack, counted on Friday; the forge is the last, counted before the doors are locked, and the gale is the ceiling itself, high as a church. A cheat must count 89 false stacks and lock 89 false doors.
